HEEWON STYLE. Minimal iconic 2:1 still, composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. NIGHT bamboo grove. LOW THREE-QUARTER. ONE DEVICE: the white winter rose as the single bright point. Young Hallakgungi (FACE from gardener portrait; ignore court silk — gray/blind-guest cloth or servant plain) kneeling, hands placing the last flower / breath into his mother’s returning form. Wonganghami (FACE from wongang) lying then half-sitting, vermilion cloth reforming, winter rose white through the forehead, eyes opening. Resurrection as tenderness, not gore — no corpse catalog. #8FBF8A as hard key on the rose and his hands. Emotional. No text. No watermark.
